Hotel & Resort Window Tinting
Is window tinting worth it for a hotel or resort?

Yes — hotels and resorts carry glass across hundreds of guest rooms plus lobbies, restaurants and sea-view glass, so the gains multiply. Film cuts indoor heat by up to 10°C for guest comfort, delivers large energy savings across every room running A/C, protects furnishings from UV fade, and keeps a clean, consistent façade — all without darkening the view.
How much does hotel window tinting cost in Thailand?

Installed film runs from ฿70/sq ft for carbon film up to ฿180/sq ft for premium sputtering. Because hotels and resorts carry large glass areas across many rooms, projects are quoted on total glass area and film tier. We measure the whole property free on-site and can phase the work wing by wing to spread cost and avoid closures.
How much can window film save a hotel on energy?

Premium ceramic and sputtering films reject the majority of heat and 99% of UV, lowering indoor temperatures by up to 10°C and cutting A/C load 20–30% per room. Multiplied across every guest room, lobby and restaurant running air-conditioning all day, that is a significant, measurable reduction in a resort's monthly electricity bill.
Will installing film disrupt guests or require closing rooms?

No. JaiDeeClear films on-site with no glass removed, and we phase the work room by room and wing by wing around your occupancy. Each room is filmed in a short window and handed straight back, so the property keeps trading throughout with minimal disruption to guests.
Does window film protect hotel interiors and furnishings?

Yes. Tropical UV fades soft furnishings, carpets, timber and art fast — a constant refurbishment cost for hotels. Our film blocks 99% of UV, protecting the interiors and finishes you invested in and extending the life of guest-room and lobby fit-outs.
Do you install hotel window film on-site across Thailand?

Yes. JaiDeeClear is a fully mobile service — certified technicians come to your hotel or resort in Bangkok, Phuket, Chonburi and beyond. We handle large multi-room projects with phased scheduling, and free on-site measurement is included with every quote.
